name: a-slot-that-failed-says-so
find:
dayFailures[DaySlot(eventID: eventID, day: day)] =
            Recorded(reason: reason, pipelineError: nil)
        endDayRegen(day, for: eventID)
breaks: a rebuild that failed releases its slot and records no reason, so the screen shows an idle day and Dan is told nothing at all, which is the spinner-over-a-failure shape one step further on (#721, L10)
